comparison.objective: Hold a release collet while pulling a pipe from a push-fit fitting; candidate locks an adjusted gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous axial collet pressing and pipe extraction versus simultaneous rotational counterholding and nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Pipe fully removed, laid flat, and fitting unmoved versus angle preserved, nuts retained, and cycles repeatable.
comparison.reason: Both require bimanual force coordination, but release-and-extract and torque-preserved adjustment are meaningfully different.
